resources.string: Before you start, please read the User Agreement and the Privacy Policy on the left. Tapping Agree and Continue means that you have read and agree to both documents. FCL does not request any permission or connect to the internet before you agree. You can review both documents or withdraw your consent at any time in Settings > About.
Failed to load this document. Please reinstall FCL.

After you withdraw consent, FCL exits immediately and asks for your consent again the next time it starts. Game files, accounts and settings on this device are not deleted. To delete them, clear the data of FCL in system settings or uninstall FCL.
